label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: Y vinieron los varones sobre las mujeres; todo generoso de corazón trajeron broche y zarcillo y anillo y collar, todo utensilio de oro, y todo varón que balanceó balanceo de oro a Jehová.
spanish: Y vinieron los varones sobre las mujeres; todo noble de corazón trajeron gancho y aro y anillo y adorno, todo objeto de oro, y todo varón que balanceó balanceo de oro a Jehová.
grammarChanges: generoso -> noble: נָדִיב also licenses willing/voluntary, not only the liberal/generous sense; 'noble' keeps both open.
broche -> gancho: חָח is hook/ring/clasp; 'broche' narrowed it to a brooch, a decorative pin not licensed by the lemma.
zarcillo -> aro: נֶזֶם is a ring whose placement (nose or ear) the lemma leaves open; 'zarcillo' wrongly fixed it as an earring.
collar -> adorno: כּוּמָז is an unidentified gold ornament, not specifically a necklace.
utensilio -> objeto: כְּלִי also denotes a vessel or article, not only a tool.
readerNote: Five nouns/adjectives were widened to Spanish terms (noble, gancho, aro, adorno, objeto) that keep the fuller range the cited Hebrew lemmas allow, instead of the narrower words the draft had selected.
